-- Play a sound by name. With a parent (a BasePart or Attachment) it is a 3D world sound; without one it
-- plays as a UI sound (client: PlayLocalSound; server: everyone hears it from SoundService).
function GameAssets.play(name: string, parent: Instance?, pitch: number?): Sound?
	local id = GameAssets.Sounds[name]
	if not id or id == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local s = Instance.new("Sound")
	s.Name = name
	s.SoundId = id
	s.Volume = VOLUMES[name] or 0.5
	s.PlaybackSpeed = pitch or (PITCHES[name] or 1) * (0.95 + math.random() * 0.1)
	if parent == nil and RunService:IsClient() then
		s.Parent = SoundService
		SoundService:PlayLocalSound(s)
		Debris:AddItem(s, 6)
		return s
	end
	s.Parent = parent or SoundService
	s:Play()
	Debris:AddItem(s, 6)
	return s
end

-- Looping background music at low volume (call once, on the client).
function GameAssets.music(name: string?, volume: number?): Sound?
	local id = GameAssets.Sounds[name or "Music"]
	if not id or id == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local s = Instance.new("Sound")
	s.Name, s.SoundId, s.Looped, s.Volume = "Music", id, true, volume or 0.25
	s.Parent = SoundService
	s:Play()
	return s
end

-- Resolve a BasePart / Model / Vector3 into a part that can hold an attachment.
local function resolveHolder(at: any): BasePart?
	if typeof(at) == "Vector3" then
		local holder = Instance.new("Part")
		holder.Name = "FxAnchor"
		holder.Anchored, holder.CanCollide, holder.CanQuery, holder.CanTouch = true, false, false, false
		holder.Transparency, holder.Size, holder.Position = 1, Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2), at
		holder.Parent = workspace
		Debris:AddItem(holder, 4)
		return holder
	end
	if typeof(at) == "Instance" then
		if at:IsA("BasePart") then
			return at
		end
		if at:IsA("Model") then
			if at.PrimaryPart then
				return at.PrimaryPart
			end
			local best: BasePart? = nil
			local bestVol = -1
			for _, d in at:GetDescendants() do
				if d:IsA("BasePart") then
					local v = d.Size.X * d.Size.Y * d.Size.Z
					if v > bestVol then
						best, bestVol = d, v
					end
				end
			end
			return best
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- A one-shot sparkle burst at a part or position (gold mixed with an optional theme colour).
function GameAssets.burst(at: any, color: Color3?, count: number?)
	local holder = resolveHolder(at)
	if not holder then
		return
	end
	local gold = GameAssets.Palette.Primary
	local a = Instance.new("Attachment")
	a.Name = "BurstAttachment"
	a.Parent = holder
	local p = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	p.Name = "BurstEmitter"
	p.Texture = GameAssets.Textures.Sparkle
	if color and color ~= gold then
		p.Color = ColorSequence.new(gold, color)
	else
		p.Color = ColorSequence.new(gold)
	end
	p.LightEmission, p.Rate, p.Speed = 1, 0, NumberRange.new(8, 16)
	p.Lifetime, p.SpreadAngle = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.0), Vector2.new(180, 180)
	p.Drag = 2
	p.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1.4), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) })
	p.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.7, 0.2),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	})
	p.Enabled = false
	p.Parent = a
	p:Emit(count or 20)
	Debris:AddItem(a, 2.5)
end

-- A slow, permanent ambient sparkle emitter on a part/model (e.g. the plaza fountain). Returns the emitter.
function GameAssets.ambient(at: any, color: Color3?, rate: number?): ParticleEmitter?
	local holder = resolveHolder(at)
	if not holder then
		return nil
	end
	local existing = holder:FindFirstChild("AmbientSparkleAttachment")

		local e = existing:FindFirstChildOfClass("ParticleEmitter")

	{ name = "Candy", mat = M.SmoothPlastic, floor = C(255, 190, 220), a1 = C(255, 90, 160), a2 = C(120, 240, 190), rail = C(255, 120, 180), dark = C(190, 70, 130) },

	{ name = "Ice", mat = M.Ice, floor = C(170, 225, 250), a1 = C(90, 190, 255), a2 = C(210, 245, 255), rail = C(80, 170, 240), dark = C(40, 110, 190) },
	{ name = "Jungle", mat = M.Grass, floor = C(70, 180, 80), a1 = C(40, 140, 60), a2 = C(250, 200, 60), rail = C(60, 150, 70), dark = C(30, 100, 45) },
	{ name = "Neon City", mat = M.Slate, floor = C(40, 36, 80), a1 = C(255, 40, 200), a2 = C(40, 240, 255), rail = C(180, 60, 255), dark = C(100, 30, 170) },
	{ name = "Desert", mat = M.Sand, floor = C(240, 205, 140), a1 = C(70, 170, 80), a2 = C(240, 130, 70), rail = C(220, 130, 60), dark = C(170, 90, 40) },
}

local function mk(parent, name, size, cf, color, mat, opts)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = name
	p.Anchored = true
	p.Size = size
	p.CFrame = cf
	p.Color = color
	p.Material = mat or M.SmoothPlastic
	if opts then
		if opts.shape then p.Shape = opts.shape end
		if opts.t then p.Transparency = opts.t end
		if opts.collide == false then p.CanCollide = false end
	end
	p.Parent = parent
	return p
end

local UP = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi / 2)
local function cyl(parent, name, h, d, cf, color, mat, opts)
	return mk(parent, name, Vector3.new(h, d, d), cf * UP, color, mat, opts)
end
local function ball(parent, name, d, cf, color, mat)
	return mk(parent, name, Vector3.new(d, d, d), cf, color, mat, { shape = Enum.PartType.Ball })
end

local function resolveTheme(theme)
	local idx, name
	if type(theme) == "number" then
		idx = theme
	elseif type(theme) == "table" then
		idx = theme.Index or theme.index
		name = theme.Name or theme.name
	elseif type(theme) == "string" then
		name = theme
	end
	if not idx and name then
		for i, d in ipairs(LOCAL) do
			if d.name == name then idx = i end
		end
	end
	idx = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(idx) or 1), 1, #LOCAL)
	if type(name) ~= "string" then
		local ok, t = pcall(PlotThemes.getTheme, idx)
		if ok and type(t) == "table" and type(t.Name) == "string" then name = t.Name end
	end
	local d = LOCAL[idx]
	return idx, (name or d.name), d
end

local function folderIn(parent, name)
	local f = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not f then
		f = Instance.new("Folder")
		f.Name = name
		f.Parent = parent
	end
	return f
end

local plazaBuilt = false

function PlazaBuilder.buildPlaza()
	if plazaBuilt then return end
	plazaBuilt = true
	local count = PlotThemes.PLOT_COUNT or 6
	local sx, sz, n, ringSum, groundY = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
	local pts = {}
	for i = 1, count do
		local ok, cf = pcall(PlotThemes.getSlotCFrame, i)
		if ok and typeof(cf) == "CFrame" then
			table.insert(pts, cf.Position)
			sx += cf.Position.X
			sz += cf.Position.Z
			n += 1
			if i == 1 then groundY = cf.Position.Y - 0.5 end
		end
	end
	local center = if n > 0 then Vector3.new(sx / n, groundY, sz / n) else Vector3.new(0, groundY, 0)
	for _, p in ipairs(pts) do
		ringSum += Vector3.new(p.X - center.X, 0, p.Z - center.Z).Magnitude
	end
	local ringR = if n > 0 then ringSum / n else 60
	local R = math.clamp(ringR - 24, 16, 30)

	local f = Instance.new("Folder")
